tools.description: Take the visitor to the Agentronics demo-booking page (Calendly) to schedule a technical demo.

note.description: Optional context about what to cover.

tools.name: compare_features
tools.description: Get the full Agentronics plan-by-plan feature comparison matrix (SDK & governance, measurement & analytics, and platform limits) as structured data.

tools.description: Get Agentronics pricing: all plans with monthly and yearly prices (USD) and headline features. Yearly billing is 16% off.

tools.description: Explain what Agentronics is, what WebMCP is, what the SDK does, and how it works in three steps.

tools.name: navigate_to
tools.description: Navigate the visitor to a page on the Agentronics site: home, pricing, docs, book (demo), sign-up, or sign-in.

tools.name: recommend_plan
tools.description: Recommend the best-fit Agentronics plan from a customer's needs (monthly agent request volume and which governance features they need), with the price and the reasons.

needMemory.description: Requires agent memory & context transfer across sessions.

dataSources.description: Number of connected data sources, or "all".

tools.description: Find the most relevant Agentronics documentation pages for a query. Returns doc titles, summaries, and links.

query.description: What you want to find in the docs.

tools.name: start_signup
